doc.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024

title: Current plans, Jeff Colella album and few gigs
summary: Smith mentions an upcoming church concert, an album with pianist Jeff Colella, scarce work and slowing down.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Okay. Well can you remember what’s the next gig that’s coming up for you?

I’m doing a little concert at the church, Pasadena Presbyterian and that thing with a guy that I’m rehearsing with today, we’re in the middle of making an album, Jeff Colella, a lovely piano player. We’re doing that now. We’re recording in a month. And work is very scarce, very scarce. And I’m at the point now where I turn down far more than I do because first of all I can’t play a four hour gig, it’s too long. I’m going to bed now by 10:00 at night. So a gig that ends at 9:00 is like oh man, there’s got to be something really good about it. I mean that’s the way it is you know. There’s a magazine called The Sun — S-U-N and on the back page they have little blurbs and the theme this one week was “the last years of your life” and one lady said, “I’m just trying to fall apart gracefully.” That’s beautiful. That’s beautiful.
I’m going to keep that in mind in the next few years.
